title: SPH3U Exit Card Readiness Package
problemAnchor: 本节课主要检查学生是否知道考试、作业、提交、材料或平台等下一步要求。

abt.and: 你已经收到本节课的重要安排。
abt.but: 如果错过材料、平台、截止日期或考试要求，学习表现会被非知识因素影响。
abt.therefore: 系统先确认你是否知道下一步行动；不通过时触发提醒或人工确认。

objective: 学生能确认本节课后的关键行动、材料、平台、截止日期或考试要求。

learningGoals.statement: Understand and follow key course operations: camera policy, access to course materials, and schedule for next class.

questions.stem: When should you turn on your camera during class?
questions.successCriteria: Student identifies that cameras should be on when the teacher requests.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students understood the camera policy mentioned during class.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think cameras should be on at all times or only at the beginning.

options.text: Only at the beginning of class
options.feedbackWrong: The teacher specifically asked everyone to turn cameras back on during the lesson, not just at the start.
The teacher did not require cameras on at all times; they only asked when needed.

options.text: Only when you have a question
options.feedbackWrong: The instruction was to turn on cameras when the teacher requests, not only when asking a question.

questions.stem: Where can you find the course document for this class?
questions.successCriteria: Student identifies the Feishu group chat as the source for the course document link.
questions.ossdExpectation: Access and use course materials as directed.
questions.stemIntent: Check if students know the location of the course document shared during class.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might look for the document on the school website or email instead of Feishu.

options.text: In the Feishu group chat link

options.feedbackWrong: The document link was shared in the group chat, not on the school website.
The link was posted in the group chat, not sent via email.

options.text: The teacher will share it later
options.feedbackWrong: The document link was already shared during class in the group chat.

questions.stem: When is the next class for SPH3U?
questions.successCriteria: Student correctly recalls that the next class is on 2026-07-07.
questions.ossdExpectation: Keep track of class schedule and attendance.
questions.stemIntent: Ensure students know when the next class meets.
questions.commonMisconception: Students might think class is later in the week or that there is no fixed schedule.

options.feedbackWrong: The teacher said class continues tomorrow, not next week.
The teacher announced class continues tomorrow, not the day after.
Class meets tomorrow; a schedule was announced.
